::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
IIT Madras-incubated startup (founders Shashwath T R and Sharan Srinivas J) building microcontrollers on the Shakti RISC-V core. Its Secure IoT S2401 taped out first-time-right in May 2024 at 28nm; customer sampling is under way (Pinetics is a named customer) and commercial production was being readied in 2026.
:::

## What does this firm design?

RISC-V microcontrollers and SoCs: the Secure IoT S2401 for smart metering and industrial IoT, and the V2600 vision SoC for edge computing (its DLI project).
